# Adoptium API fixtures

Unmodified responses of `https://api.adoptium.net/v3/assets/latest/<major>/hotspot?architecture=<arch>&image_type=jre&os=<os>&vendor=eclipse`
fetched on 2026-10-17 for Java 21 Linux x64, Java 21 Windows x64 and Java 25 macOS aarch64.
They contain only metadata (release names, package links, sizes, SHA-256 values); no runtime
archive is stored in this repository.
